evidence_stream: CSRO identity, vehicle, urgency competition, and solicitation-number conflict
source_context: COFC-reported administrative-record chronology plus USAspending award fields
dependency_rule: Court and spending records are complementary descriptions of one procurement; the unresolved solicitation identifiers are not two events
what_it_establishes: Seven invitees, four timely proposals, single-award vehicle, $915 million maximum, and $250 minimum obligation
cannot_support: Who shaped the scope or invitee list; political influence; a resolved RFP identifier
effect_on_12939: Adds a non-GEO policy/urgency existence proof; not applicable to GEO selection

evidence_stream: Two identified CSRO child-order money stocks
source_context: USAspending award details and derived arithmetic
dependency_rule: Both orders are one Salus/CSRO economic channel; obligations, outlays, current value, and potential value remain distinct
what_it_establishes: $697,901,214.99 obligations and $386,730,317.83 reported outlays across two identified child orders
cannot_support: Payment, profit, revenue, political causation, or selection rationale
effect_on_12939: No change; scale is not causal evidence

dependency_rule: Technical ratings and evaluated price belong to the same selection event and are not independent votes
what_it_establishes: Salus alone had high confidence for technical approach and had the lowest $1,409,688 evaluated scenario price
cannot_support: That $1,409,688 was award value; fairness of ground rules; absence of subtler influence
effect_on_12939: Makes ordinary comparative selection plausible; does not explain a GEO choice

evidence_stream: Potential OCI recognition, mitigation, and waiver
source_context: Agency determinations quoted in the COFC opinion
dependency_rule: Appearance findings and waiver are two parts of one agency risk-treatment decision
what_it_establishes: DHS acknowledged appearances of biased ground rules, unequal information, and impropriety and approved a waiver based on mitigation and urgency
cannot_support: That an actual OCI existed; that no OCI existed; political direction; exoneration
effect_on_12939: Preserves process-risk caution; does not move GEO-specific ACH

evidence_stream: GAO withdrawal and distinct COFC dispositions
dependency_rule: Threshold and alternative grounds are separate legal propositions in one case, not independent causal evidence
what_it_establishes: No GAO merits decision; separate Article III, statutory-standing, interested-party, and prejudice dispositions
cannot_support: General merits exoneration; adjudicated political-favor finding; treatment of every procurement criticism
effect_on_12939: No change; court posture is not applicable to GEO selection

evidence_stream: Later direct ICE aircraft-maintenance purchase order

cannot_support: General DHS architecture, political causation, or CSRO economics
effect_on_12939: Slightly reinforces policy/urgency mechanism plausibility; no GEO effect
